principle: AI is an assistant. The therapist makes the final decision at every stage.
flow: Demographics -> baseline ratings -> therapist patient-state -> fixed opening -> initial quadrant recommendation -> therapist selects quadrant -> personalized questions within selected quadrant -> therapist records patient response -> indicator extraction -> ambiguity resolution -> chakra scoring -> next quadrant/deep-dive recommendation -> therapist continues or stops -> top two supported chakra findings -> approved raga/prahar mapping -> editable therapist prescription -> patient prescription

demographics.gender_rule: Do not use gender as a quadrant or chakra scoring signal.
demographics.age_rule: Use age mainly for communication and assessment suitability; do not assume a chakra from age.
demographics.occupation_rule: Use occupation as context for questions about work/study stress, routine, or environment; do not assign a quadrant merely because of job title.

evidence_priority: current issue / main reason for help
initial_quadrant_recommendation.note: Starting weights are engineering hypotheses and require therapist-labelled validation; they are not clinical truth.

quadrant_selection.rule: AI recommends; therapist selects the quadrant to explore.
quadrant_selection.after_selection: AI may suggest 2-3 patient-specific questions based on the selected quadrant, current issue, previous answers, and untested high-value attributes.

adaptive_questioning.principle: Do not ask the same generic questions to everyone.
selection_priority: directly explore the patient's stated problem within the selected quadrant
resolve an ambiguity that could change chakra ranking
fill an important unanswered quadrant attribute
clarify trigger, timing, intensity, impact, or coping

continue_until: two chakras pass the imbalance gate

next_step_logic: If selected quadrant has strong unresolved evidence, recommend deeper exploration there.
If another quadrant has stronger unexplored relevance, recommend it as the next candidate.
If an indicator maps to multiple chakras, recommend clarification before ranking that evidence as confirmed.
If two chakras pass the gate, show top two and allow therapist to finish or continue.
If no two pass, say more assessment is needed rather than forcing a top two.

raga_mapping.prahara: Use approved raga time metadata; do not invent a time.
raga_mapping.safety: Apply existing safety/governance flags and do not use unreviewed practitioner mappings as clinical evidence.

human_oversight: therapist decides when assessment is complete
